item.description:

The versatile mRNA platform enables researchers to manufacture bespoke vaccines for each patient in just six weeks. Some arms of the clinical trial paired the new mRNA vaccines with Merck's Keytruda, a monoclonal antibody checkpoint inhibitor that enables immune cells to identify and kill cancer cells. The patients in the clinical trial had been diagnosed with Stage IIB to Stage IV melanoma cancers. All had visible signs of their tumors surgically removed before beginning the clinical trial.
